assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and all three KEY_AREA polygons are repository-provided provisional geometry.
assumptions.impact: Machine checks and design discussion can proceed, but formal professional scoring, statutory conclusions and engineering judgment must wait for official polygons and recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Repository Issue #1029 records an approximately 2.26 km public location discrepancy between the provisional Dazhongsi key-area polygon and Dazhongsi Station.
assumptions.impact: The source polygon is not translated or corrected by this submission; official replacement triggers a full-chain geometry, metric, figure, HTML and PDF rebuild.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, statutory density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire safety and heritage controls are not available as confirmed inputs.
assumptions.impact: All related values remain unknown; the proposal describes only reversible prototypes and governance mechanisms.

assumptions.statement: No government, enterprise, merchant, university, funding or venue partnership is assumed.
assumptions.impact: Named roles are proposed interfaces, not commitments or endorsements.

assumptions.statement: OpenStreetMap may be used only for road, transit and candidate merchant context under ODbL attribution; missing tags do not prove absence.
assumptions.impact: OSM is not used for boundaries, statutory controls, actual shop counts or eligibility conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Submitted building footprints represent reversible storefront, prototyping and public-service modules, not surveyed or proposed permanent buildings.
assumptions.impact: Professional teams must confirm siting, accessibility, fire safety, utilities, heritage and construction feasibility before any implementation.

assumptions.statement: No personal data, merchant transaction data, trade secrets, precise addresses or uncleared imagery are included.
assumptions.impact: Future pilots require purpose limitation, consent where applicable, minimization, retention limits, human review, refusal, stop and exit paths.
